title: Resend abuse posture (AD-15) fake-success wiring has no integration test
detail: AD-15 abuse posture applies to resend (AC6). The pure is_resend_timing_suspicious is unit-tested and answer POST/PUT abuse are integration-pinned, but no test POSTs /resend with honeypot/timing values to pin the fake-success wiring.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test POSTing /reference/:token/resend with _website filled (and a sub-2s _form_loaded_at) asserting view_ressed renders and no remint row or audit row is written.

detail: The complete-draft GET that renders the review screen is untested at the handler level. view_review is unit-tested in form_pages_test, but no integration test seeds a full draft and GETs the bare URL. W1 targeted review reach.

detail: clamp_current (the ?q= rule) is unit-tested, but no integration test GETs /reference/:token?q=<answered-id> to pin that saved values pre-fill and data-current lands on that question (Change/Back navigation).

title: Resend guarded-write 0-row stand-down (AD-14) branch untested
evidence:
// 0 rows: the state moved under the referee — re-render the truth.
    Ok(pog.Returned(_, [])) -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> old_token)
detail: The guarded-write stand-down (concurrent state change between classify and remint) is untested; the delivered and all-failed branches are. This is the AD-14 0-row discipline the design relies on.
recommended_fix: Add a test that flips the row terminal between the expired GET and resend_with_send, asserting the bare-URL redirect and no remint/audit.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 critical paths FULL (landing GET, answer POST/PUT save, CSRF stack through middleware, resend delivered+rollback, catch-all 404). P1 ~81%: 3 gaps (review GET dispatch, ?q= GET dispatch, resend abuse wiring). Overall ~80% (several P2 error branches untested: POST unknown-token, bad_request, PUT malformed-JSON, resend 0-row, LookupQueryFailed 500s).
detail: P0 100%, P1 ~81% (3 wiring gaps on user-facing/invariant paths), overall ~80%. Lands in CONCERNS band, not PASS, because P1 is below 90%.
recommended_fix: Close the 3 P1 gaps (resend abuse wiring, complete-draft review GET, ?q= pre-fill GET) and add error-branch coverage for POST unknown-token and PUT malformed-JSON to lift overall above 80%.
